# Roll out a feature to 10% of users, and know exactly who gets it.

> A free, open-source alternative to LaunchDarkly, Flagsmith and Unleash: percentage rollouts that stay sticky, targeting rules, segments, prerequisites and a kill switch in one small server. Simulate a rollout and see exactly who would flip before you ship it, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
